gloss: to start dating; to begin associating with

definitions.gloss: to start going out with someone; to begin a relationship or association
definitions.explanation: To begin a romantic relationship, or more generally to start keeping company with a person or group. A compound of {付|つ}き{合|あ}う (to associate with, to date) and {始|はじ}める (to begin).

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}は{先月|せんげつ}{付|つ}き{合|あ}い{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: The two of them started dating last month.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}と{付|つ}き{合|あ}い{始|はじ}めてから{半年|はんとし}になる。
examples.english: It's been half a year since I started going out with her.

examples.japanese: {同|おな}じサークルの{仲間|なかま}と{付|つ}き{合|あ}い{始|はじ}めてから、{週末|しゅうまつ}が{楽|たの}しくなった。
examples.english: Since I started spending time with friends from the same club, my weekends have become more fun.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive ichidan verb. The partner is marked with と: (person)と{付|つ}き{合|あ}い{始|はじ}める. A compound of {付|つ}き{合|あ}う plus the auxiliary {始|はじ}める (to begin doing).

USAGE:
- Most often means to enter a romantic relationship, but can also mean simply to begin associating with people or a group.
- The plain past {付|つ}き{合|あ}い{始|はじ}めた is common when stating when a relationship began.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {彼|かれ}と{付|つ}き{合|あ}い{始|はじ}める: to start dating him
- {付|つ}き{合|あ}い{始|はじ}めたばかり: to have only just started going out
